changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Added the verified two-DGX-Spark SGLang TP2 profile as a thin, immutable Vonk recipe adaptation.
changes.details: The launch preserves SGLang's DGX Spark choices: CUDA 13 ARM64, Triton attention, Marlin W4A16 FP4 and MoE kernels, page size 128, unified radix cache, bounded cache ratios, disabled prefill CUDA graphs, and native two-node ConnectX-7 rendezvous.

changes.summary: Pinned the complete official Inkling Small NVFP4 snapshot and its built-in MTP weights at b6a99534.
changes.details: All 170,764,923,366 bytes are enumerated with exact file hashes. The model remains capped to a conservative 64K serving context so the two 128 GB unified-memory nodes retain cache and runtime headroom above the roughly 171 GB snapshot.

changes.summary: Exposed offline text, image, and audio reasoning through one OpenAI-compatible multimodal endpoint.
changes.details: Clients send image_url and audio_url parts as base64 data URIs, or OpenAI input_audio with WAV or MP3 bytes, alongside text. External media URLs are intentionally unavailable after installation because runtime networking is disabled; images should be 40-4096 px and WAV audio should be 16 kHz and ideally under two minutes.
